job: Write an answer that runs over several lines.
purpose: The input's skin on a native textarea. rows sets the starting height; data-fd-autogrow makes it grow with the text up to eight lines (data-max-rows changes that), then scroll. A counter in the field footer shows the limit when maxlength is set.
useWhen: The answer is a sentence or more: a description, a prompt, a note.
The text length varies a lot and the field should grow with it (data-fd-autogrow).

avoidWhen.when: The text is code or JSON that needs checking.
The value is a list with one item per line that should show as items.
The value is names with values, one pair per line.

variants.useWhen: A compact note field in a dense panel.
The layout cannot take a drag handle.
Grows with its text, so people see all they wrote.
